detected_defects.description: The LIMIT_LOCATION constraint 'Brow Range' on bone browUp_L has an influence of 0.2, whereas the corresponding right-side bone browUp_R has an influence of 1.0.
detected_defects.likely_root_cause: Asymmetric constraint configuration or accidental adjustment during rigging.

suggested_repairs: Set the influence of the 'Brow Range' constraint on bone browUp_L to 1.0 to match browUp_R and restore symmetry.
